review_basis: Reconciles the pending lane candidate opencode/p2-longlegs-fsm @ ad4dcd6e/dbff3a4b (which was based on merge-base 086ed858) onto the approved native baseline f14c6851, preserving the #397 lifecycle accessors (pc_p2_long_legs_count/registered) that only exist on the approved line.

changes.host: Ticks pc_p2_long_legs_fsm per registered actor from the draw path (no IKSystemMgr in port): synthesizes landing/flick key edges from audit frame times at 30 fps, feeds nearest-target/accumulating-Pikmin/health/roll inputs, and logs state/foot/shell intents. Awake actors become damageable after landing key 2; Stay remains bitter-immune.
changes.foot_crush: Source landing key-2 foot press is applied as an InteractFlick (knockback 100, source pressDamage) to alive Pikmin within the documented 60-unit port radius.
changes.corpse_guard: FSM now advances only when corpse=false, so a dead registration cannot re-enter the policy or emit a foot-crush from a corpse draw (review action from PIKMIN2_WAVE3_REVIEW_437).
changes.ctest: Registers p2_long_legs_fsm_test and p2_snagret_fsm_test in CMakeLists.txt; both policy test sources existed on the approved line but were not wired to ctest (only p2_dangomushi_hazard_test was).

verification.ctest_policy: ctest -R 'p2_' -> 20/20 passed across long_legs/snagret/dangomushi, bombsarai_* (7), fuefuki_* (4) and bigtreasure_* (6)
verification.assert_activation: The engine-free policy tests performed state transitions inside assert(), which Release -DNDEBUG compiled out; ctest re-registration would have been vacuous. Added #undef NDEBUG (before <cassert>) to the long_legs/snagret/dangomushi/bombsarai test units and bounded the induction test's induce() loop. All ten policy gates now execute their assertions.
verification.induction_fix: tools/p2_bombsarai_induction_test.cpp now registers and passes; it previously hung because the compiled-out throwBomb()/update() side effects left an unbounded while(!induce()) loop.

tick_hook.change: Moved the source-FSM tick from the family draw path (only on-camera actors advanced) to BTeki::update() via a one-line additive hook in src/plugPikiNakata/tekibteki.cpp, beside pc_p2_snow_update. `pc_p2_long_legs_draw` now only renders. Dead actors are skipped via isAlive(), preserving the corpse-guard behavior.
